rationale: With only 11 minutes to close and mandatory market liquidation at session end, the risk/reward is unfavorable — the ATR per 5-minute bar is $0.13, leaving minimal room for a meaningful move before forced exit. Price action over the last five 1-minute candles shows a steady drift lower with declining momentum and no clear directional catalyst, while the spread and slippage on liquidation would likely consume any small gain. The account already carries a realized loss today, and initiating a position this close to close adds unnecessary execution risk without a high-conviction setup.
